beats.story: Another minute and forty seconds until the workweek officially begins, but already the cubicles are fully stocked. Everyone hunches over their screens. Everyone, except Caitlin. After a weekend of overthinking everything -- the night with Cliff, Caitlin's HR meeting, Armin's upcoming appointment, my parents, and my life in general, including the hour-long freakout on Saturday night after realizing I hadn't seen my birth certificate in a while -- I should be relieved to be here. This morning, when I went outside, just seeing Cliff's car there on the side of the road was a relief on its own. He's not totally avoiding me yet. But as soon as I slipped into the passenger seat, it was clear he was on another planet, hardly talking and picking up his phone to text at stoplights. Maybe Caitlin's complaints had gotten to him after all.
beats.story_cn: 距离工作周正式开始还有一分四十秒，隔间里早已座无虚席。所有人都弓着身子盯着屏幕。所有人，除了凯特琳。经过一个周末反复思量所有事——和克里夫共度的那晚、凯特琳的HR会议、阿尔明即将到来的约见、我父母，以及我整个人生，包括发现很久没见出生证明后周六晚长达一小时的崩溃——来到这儿我本该感到解脱。今早出门时，仅仅看见克里夫的车停在路边就已让我松了口气。他还没完全躲着我。但刚溜进副驾驶座，就明显发现他魂不守舍，几乎不说话，等红灯时还总拿起手机发短信。或许凯特琳的抱怨终究还是影响到他了。

beats.story: But the worst thought hit when we passed the ice-cream shop we had the shakes at, and he tensed. What if he's been put off after that chat, reliving the conversation and all the shit I said, just like I've been doing? Now with Caitlin's desk empty, her monitor blank, it's like a doom spiral with no end in sight. Armin gets up and heads toward the printer room. I try not to look at him too hard. This morning, he emailed Cliff to confirm their appointment will be Wednesday. The air in my lungs sifts tighter. My hand acts practically on its own accord as I rage click the meeting link.
beats.story_cn: 但最糟糕的念头在我们路过那家一起喝过奶昔的冰淇淋店时袭来——他突然绷紧了身体。万一他被那次谈话影响了呢？反复回溯对话和我说过的那些蠢话，就像我现在这样？如今凯特琳的桌空了，屏幕黑着，这简直是个看不到尽头的厄运漩涡。阿尔明起身走向打印室。我努力不去紧盯他。今早他邮件确认了和克里夫周三的约见。我肺里的空气骤然收紧。手几乎不受控制般，我愤怒狂点会议链接。

"Caitlin booked a last-minute PTO -- can you two cover any inventory specs that come in?" Where the hell is she? There were no emails re the PTO in Rhonda's or Greg's inbox this morning, which means she must've arranged it via text. Or in person on Friday . .
beats.story_cn: 混着上课旷工不符合阿尔明的作风，但这倒能解释他持续的疲惫。我把日程表抄在一张纸上。这也许能成为对付他的筹码。正把纸塞进抽屉，朗达伴着椅子吱呀声缓缓起身，转向我和阿尔明这片工位。“凯特琳临时请了假——要是有库存规格说明送过来，你们俩能接一下吗？”她到底去哪了？今早朗达和格雷格的收件箱里都没有关于请假的邮件，这意味着她肯定是短信安排的。或者周五当面请的……

beats.story: . "I'd be happy to take the lead there," I say, as I press a smile in Armin's direction. His eyes are tinged red from lack of sleep, and he merely shrugs and turns back to his monitor. Rhonda smiles extra hard toward me as she grabs her favorite I'd Rather Be Crafting mug. "Jolene, you're a star." "Thanks." I smile, as Armin pulls his headphones over his ears with a neutral expression. I need to learn my lesson: taking on extra work for him is not the way to this guy's heart. But then another doom-filled theory hits: What if they thought it was better for Caitlin to not be here in the fallout of her HR meeting? What if they're planning on acting on her claims today, and she painted me as so unhinged she'd be safer off the premises when they escort me out?
beats.story_cn: “我很乐意牵头处理。”我对阿明扯出一个公式化的微笑。他眼底泛着熬夜的血丝，只是耸耸肩便转回屏幕。朗达抓起她最爱的“宁愿在做手工”马克杯，朝我绽开过分灿烂的笑容：“乔琳，你真是及时雨。”“过奖。”我微笑时，阿明已用面无表情的动作戴上耳机。我该记取教训：替他分担额外工作绝非通往这家伙内心的路径。但另一个阴郁的推测骤然浮现：或许他们正庆幸凯特琳不在场？若她借HR会议之机控诉我行为失常，此刻他们是否正策划将我押送出局，而她早被描绘成需要远离风暴中心的受害者？

I grin extra hard toward Rhonda. "Always happy to help. So nice Caitlin's taking a long weekend. Did she say what she was up to?" Armin's shoulders square just a touch as Rhonda purses her lips and says, "She said she wanted to spend the day with her boyfriend. She'll be back tomorrow." "Lovely." I smile and lock eyes with Armin, who is now staring directly at me. I try to look pleasantly unweird, but the guy keeps his expression neutral.
beats.story_cn: 唯一让我清醒的念头是：凯特琳绝不会自愿错过围观我职场崩塌的戏码。她本该端着爆米花坐在前排。我朝朗达挤出更热络的笑容：“乐意效劳。凯特琳能休长假真好，她说去忙什么了吗？”阿明肩膀几不可察地绷紧，朗达抿嘴答道：“她说要陪男友，明天回来。”“真温馨。”我微笑时与阿明目光相撞，他正直直盯着我。我努力维持不尬不自然的表情，那家伙却始终摆出张扑克脸。

beats.story: He's a tough egg to crack. It's not until Rhonda gets up to head for lunch, once again announcing to nobody in particular that she's going to buy a Greek salad, that I decide to log off and head to the kitchenette in the copy room to grab the Tupperware of ashe reshteh I actually remembered to bring. I do my best to ignore the disturbing sights and smells of the other lunch boxes and long-orphaned containers that nobody will take liability for. As I'm walking back toward my desk for my key card, I spot Armin heading toward our pods with a blue Gatorade -- fresh from the hallway vending machine -- in hand. And the idea trickles into my brain sudden and sharp. I've only ever seen this man do one thing with Cool Blue Thirst Quencher. I round the corner and it's almost too perfect. I skulk toward Rhonda's cubicle just as Armin finishes pouring around three tablespoons of Gatorade into Joey's dirt, before he pulls a pen from her holder on her desk.
beats.story_cn: 这男人像枚难撬的硬壳坚果。直到朗达再次向全办公室广播她要去买希腊沙拉，我才决定登出系统，前往复印室茶水间取我终于记得带的“波斯香草面”保鲜盒。我竭力无视其他午餐盒与来路不明陈年容器散发的诡异气味与景象。回工位取门禁卡时，瞥见阿明拿着瓶蓝色佳得乐——刚从走廊自动贩卖机取出——走向我们的工作区。一个念头如冷箭刺入脑海：我只见过这男人用“酷蓝解渴”干过一件事。转过墙角时场景完美得惊人。我潜行至朗达隔间附近，恰好看见阿明往乔伊的盆栽土里倒了约三汤匙佳得乐，随即从她笔筒抽走一支钢笔。

beats.story: He changes his signature to have different job titles. In one note, there's a photo of him sitting in Gregory's office, feet on the table. In another, he tells them he had to miss dinner because of an accounting convention he was speaking at. Armin the executive accounting manager who is always at work? Armin of ye old dirty PlayStation controller, giving a damn conference to people? Holy hell. And over and over again, I find my name. Apparently, it wasn't just Armin attending that fake conference; he wrote "Jolene and I." "Jolene and I can't visit tonight." "I'll be with Jolene this weekend." Most of these excuses seem to hinge on the fact that I'm in night school because "I don't want to be a secretary forever." Even as a fake girlfriend, I seem to need improvement.
beats.story_cn: 他不断更换签名栏里的头衔。其中一封邮件附了张照片：他坐在格雷戈里的办公室里，双脚翘在桌上。另一封里，他告诉父母，因为要在会计研讨会上发言而错过了晚餐。那个自称永远在公司的执行会计经理阿明？那个还留着老式脏兮兮游戏手柄、正儿八经给人做会议报告的阿明？见鬼。而我反反复复看到自己的名字。显然，参加那场假会议的不只是阿明一人；他写的是“我和乔琳”。“我和乔琳今晚没法过去了”。“这个周末我要和乔琳在一起”。这些借口大多都围绕着一个核心：我在上夜校，因为“我不想永远当秘书”。即便作为假冒女友，我似乎仍需改进。

beats.story: No, this must be another person named Jolene. That has to be it. My name isn't the most uncommon. I click on another email and nearly scream when a photo of my own face fills up the monitor. It's a terrible picture of me and Armin standing next to each other at last year's corporate Christmas lunch. I remember they were handing out door prizes when someone basically assaulted us with an impromptu demand to smile for the camera. Armin sent it with the subject line: "Engagement Photo." Wow. Here I was berating myself for being a weirdo around Armin, cringing every time Caitlin implied that I was interested in him because of that one Instagram message.
beats.story_cn: 不，这肯定是另一个叫乔琳的人。一定是这样。我的名字又不算独一无二。我点开另一封邮件，当屏幕被我自己的脸占满时差点尖叫出来。那是一张我和阿尔敏在去年企业圣诞午餐会上并肩而立的糟糕合影。我记得当时正在发抽奖礼品，有人突然强按着我们面对镜头笑一笑。阿尔敏把照片发了过来，标题写着：“订婚照”。好家伙。我这边还在为自己在阿尔敏面前表现得像个怪胎而自责，每次凯特琳暗示“就因为那条ins消息”我才对他感兴趣时，我都尴尬得想钻地缝。

beats.story: Meanwhile, he's sending pics of me to his parents. I click into his calendar again and note the address of his meeting with his parents tonight -- or, I guess, our meeting. I recognize the location, Shiraz Bakery. It's a Persian café that specializes in preparing pastries for weddings. What are they doing there? Is this part of Armin and my engagement or something? How deep does this web of lies go? I stare at the bakery website.
beats.story_cn: 与此同时，他居然把我的照片发给了他父母。我再次点开他的日历，记下他今晚与父母会面的地址——或者说，是我们的会面。我认得那个地方，设拉子面包房。那是一家波斯咖啡馆，专门准备婚礼糕点。他们去那儿干什么？这是阿尔敏和我的“订婚”安排吗？这个谎言之网到底有多深？我盯着面包房的网站。

beats.story: It's not too hard to get there on the bus; it's actually on the way home. I type a message: JOLENE: Hey Cliff, turns out something came up after work. I won't be needing a ride tonight. His dots bounce. Then stop. And bounce again before his message appears: CLIFF: Sounds good. I'll see you tomorrow. Armin returns from lunch with a greasy Tacos Mexico bag in hand. He averts his eyes as soon as we lock them, sliding out of sight behind his monitor. He told his parents I'll try to attend dinner tonight.
beats.story_cn: 坐公交去那里不算太远；其实正好顺路回家。我打出一条消息：乔琳：嘿克里夫，下班后临时有点事。今晚不用你送我了。他的状态指示符开始跳动。然后停住。又跳动了一下，消息才出来：克里夫：好的。明天见。阿尔敏午休回来，手里拎着油腻腻的“墨西哥卷饼”纸袋。我们目光刚一接触，他就移开视线，滑到了显示器后面。他告诉他父母，我今晚会尽量去赴宴。
